name: Camus IV
description: Camus IV was the fourth planet in the Camus system of the Illisurevimurasi sector, located within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Sometime prior to the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca once vacationed on Camus IV, but Solo became seasick while floating among the planet's ocean waves.
lead_paragraphs: Camus IV was the fourth planet in the Camus system of the Illisurevimurasi sector, located within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
